overview.text: 四 means “four.” Its present form encloses inner 儿-form strokes within 囗. Its origin is disputed: it may directly represent the numeral or have been borrowed from another graph.

components.text: 囗 is the enclosing outer shape in the present graph; its ancient role is unresolved.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
